# URINE CULTURE MAIN ORDER MENU

[Minneapolis Clinical On-Call Schedule \(Infectious Disease\)](orz-min-on-call-schedule)

# Urine Culture is NOT indicated for the following conditions alone:

- Cloudy urine
- Malodorous urine
- Discolored urine
- When a urinary catheter is placed
- Automatic on admission
- End of therapy re-testing

# Urine cultures should be ordered in patients with symptoms of a urinary tract infection, during pregnancy at appropriate screening intervals, and prior to an invasive urologic procedure.

# Select indication for urine culture your patient has to place lab order:

[Fever or sepsis with no other identifiable cause](lrtz-mb-urine-culture-clean-catch-fever-sepsis-no-other-cause)

[Dysuria, frequency, or urgency](lrtz-mb-urine-culture-clean-catch-dysuria-freq-urg)

[Flank, suprapubic, or pelvic pain](lrtz-mb-urine-culture-clean-catch-pain-flank-suprapubic-pelvic)

[CVA tenderness](lrtz-mb-urine-culture-clean-catch-cva-tenderness)

[Acute hematuria](lrtz-mb-urine-culture-clean-catch-acute-hematuria)

[PRE-OPERATIVE SCREENING for urologic procedure](lrtz-mb-urine-culture-clean-catch-pre-0p-screening-urologic)

[Pregnant and due for screening](lrtz-mb-urine-culture-clean-catch-pregnant-screening)

[Increased bladder spasticity or autonomic dysreflexia in patients with](lrtz-mb-urine-culture-clean-catch-sci-or-neurogenic-bladder)
spinal cord injury or neurologic deficit
[Altered mental status with no other identifiable cause](lrtz-mb-urine-culture-clean-catch-altered-mental-status)
(note that UC not usually indicated, call ID with questions)

[OR/IR Sterile Aspirate Collection Only](lrtz-set-or-ir-sterile-aspirate-collection-only-2)
